title: Sindhu Advances at French Open After Tough Opening Match
indian_angle: India's top women's singles player Sindhu secured her spot in the next round of a prestigious BWF Super 750 event.
summary: Sindhu overcame a strong challenge from Katethong, winning 21-14, 8-21, 21-18 to advance in the French Open Round of 32.

title: Indian Para Shuttlers Thulasimathi, Nitesh Reach Mixed Doubles Final
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton players Thulasimathi and Nitesh have secured at least a silver medal at the Asian Para Games, with other Indian shuttlers also winning bronze.
summary: Thulasimathi and Nitesh defeated a Chinese pair 21-19, 14-21, 21-17 to reach the SL3-SU5 mixed doubles final at the Asian Para Games 2026, while India also secured two bronze medals in other categories.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has formed a dedicated Athletes Committee to ensure better representation and welfare for Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for players' voices and addressing their concerns.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway for BWF World Championships
indian_angle: India's top junior talent is undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, to prepare Indian junior players.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is investing in coaching development by conducting an advanced Level-1 course, enhancing the quality of coaching for Indian players.
summary: The BAI is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will be implemented across India's domestic junior tournaments, impacting the development and competitive experience of young Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
